profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded enterprise software company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, that trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM. The company reported revenue of approximately $41.525 billion for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, according to its most recent 10-K filing. Its core business is customer relationship management software, delivered as a cloud platform.

On the AI side, Salesforce offers several products across its portfolio. Slack AI is embedded directly in the Slack messaging platform and, according to the company's own site, provides channel and thread summarization, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, inline translation, and workflow automation. The site states that customer data is not used to train the underlying large language models, and that those models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Slackbot is described as a personal AI agent within Slack that adapts to a user's tone and style. Separately, Salesforce offers Salesforce Einstein and Agentforce, a CRM-embedded AI and autonomous agent platform, and Tableau AI, which incorporates Einstein capabilities for natural language queries and business intelligence within Tableau, with a Trust Layer governance component.

The held facts note that Salesforce has 161 legal matters with California exposure on record. The company also has a presence in the MCP server registry through several third-party integrations, including tools for Salesforce administration, SOQL querying, and DevOps pipeline management built by external developers on the Smithery, Cirra, and Serpent Cloud registries.
